answer: The canyon register is checked at draw time, whisper lists the eligible set, and signal seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 46 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 46 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. Each copy needs 8 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
